details.reasoning: The predicted answer gives George Harrison, which matches the gold target. The additional nomination count and years do not contradict the target.
details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. The citation identifies the set of artists who have won Album of the Year more than once and gives their nomination counts and years.
2. George Harrison has 8 nominations, listed in 8 different years: 1966, 1967, 1968, 1969, 1970, 1972, 1973, and 1990.
3. Frank Sinatra also has 8 nominations, but two are from 1959, so they span only 7 distinct years. The other multiple-win artists listed have fewer than 8 nominations.
4. Therefore, George Harrison has the most nominations among multiple winners when each nomination must be from a different year.
